responsibility: Declares the NumberIO interface for reading, writing, and converting ordinal numeric values and their binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal textual forms. It exposes the array-based numeric formatting/parsing API used throughout the boot runtime, separate from floating-point conversion and higher-level dynamic-string helpers.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration file for the GNumberIO pair: it publishes the numeric text conversion and I/O routines, while GNumberIO.cc implements the formatting/parsing algorithms, buffer limits, whitespace handling, and runtime failure checks.
